\[Deathmatch II] available from: 2025/9/9 11:00 (UTC+8)[/p][p]How to play:

Challenges of varying difficulty and fabulous prizes await players in \[Summer Heat Brawl]. Clear the Stages to win Rewards including \[Dream Crystal].[/p][p]d. \[Divine Power Deathmatch Season 47] Now Available[/p][p]Event Time:
2025/9/2 11:00～2025/9/9 10:59 (UTC +8)[/p][p]Prerequisites:
Clear Story Stage 2-10[/p][p]How to Play:
– Use \[Deathmatch Ticket] to enter the Stage and challenge the Limited-Time Boss.[/p][p]Reward Info:

3%:
Vast Firmament Phoenix
Illusory Renegade Cartilla

Goddess of Envy Inase

The Pale Angel[/p][p]Other Explanations:

3. DEF increased by 50%

Clear 20th floor of Skybreak Tower[/p][p]Rewards:

the rewards also include Gold of Divine Perception Fragment. After collecting a certain amount, players can use the Alchemy System to alchemize it into Gold of Divine Perception.[/p][p]f. \[Virtual Dreamland] Login Event[/p][p]Event Time:

※ The login card will disappear after logging in to the game for 14 days.

– Requirements: Players will be able to purchase Seductive Contract (Lynn – Racing Queen) x12 5 times, Seductive Contract (Lynn – Racing Queen) x2 30 times, and Seductive Contract (Lynn – Racing Queen) x1 (limited) 60 times after unlocking the in-game Store
– Please Note: Seductive Contracts will be converted into Gold once the summon pool closes. (100,000 Gold/Seductive Contract x1)[/p][p]p. \[Pass Event] Season 10 Now Available[/p][p]Event Time:
2025/8/26 11:00 ~ 2025/9/16 10:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]During the event period, completing Pass quests will increase your Pass level and provide all kinds of rewards. After purchasing a paid plan, you can additionally receive rich rewards such as Boudoir Accessories, Bond Contracts, Bond Stones, and Dream Crystals when you level up your Pass.

※ After purchasing the basic plan, you can buy an upgraded plan to receive the full content equivalent to the highest-tier paid plan.[/p][p]\[Basic Paid Plan]

[h2]l. Optimizations / Fixes[/h2]
- Boost Relic auto-select feature has been adjusted. The "SSR or lower" option has been removed from the "Rarity" category to prevent accidental use of SSR relics for boosting relics.
- Optimized the chapters in the trial stages, all trial stages will be displayed directly.
- Adjusted the "Revenge" effect, increasing the damage increased per stack from 1% to 2%.
- If any Monthly Pass is valid, increase the Stamina limit by 80 points (unable to stack).
- Stages with the Stamina cost of 1 or less can no longer be rushed. These stages mostly only offer first-clear rewards, and in order to prevent the wastage of Rush Tokens and Stamina, we have removed the Rush function for these stages.
